data.one_liner: Client to interact with Dart SDK's frontend_server compiler.
data.what_it_does: Provides a programmatic interface to start and communicate with the frontend_server compiler bundled with the Dart SDK. It supports compiling Dart code, hot reload, hot restart, and expression compilation for DDC apps.
use_when: Building tools that need to compile Dart code via the SDK
Implementing custom development servers or IDE integrations
Enabling hot reload or restart in DDC-based workflows
avoid_when: Developing general Flutter or Dart applications that don't require compiler interaction
Using it outside the Dart SDK environment
strengths: Supports DDC library bundle format and hot reload
Offers native asset and source inclusion
weaknesses: Highly dependent on the Dart SDK version
Not suitable for general app development
Requires same SDK build for all artifacts
